title: Lá rơi trước ngõ
about: Round 27, ke-chuyen ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác"), autumn in the album of a year's waiting: C-sharp minor in 3/4 at 72 bpm. Its motif falls as a leaf does, a third at a time over three bars (G#-E-C#, each with a lean: G#5-F#5-E5, E5-D#5-C#5, C#5-B4-A4), then the wind lifts it again up the chord. The piano alone first; then its left hand turns to a slow waltz (bass on the beat, the chord after it: texture sparse) under the cellos' second line; the middle in E major, the cellos answering where the tune holds; the climax with the strings and rolled chords, the falling motif from E6, and D major (the Neapolitan) before G#7; the piano again with the violas at the sentences' ends. An original tune. Round 28 ("tôi muốn các bài sẽ có không gian giống ambient hơn, tiếng piano mờ ảo hơn, nhạc dễ ngủ hơn"): on ke-chuyen-mo, a hall nearly twice as long, the piano softer and hazier, 63 bpm (was 72), every section softer and the climax low, sparse chords for the rolled ones, the plucked cellos and the octaves left out. Round 29 ("tôi thấy không gian ambient đã ổn nhưng muốn tiếng piano gần tai hơn, độ vang và tiếng giống tiếng piano relax hơn"): on ke-chuyen-relax, the same hall, the piano nearer, clearer and less of the Rhodes under it. Round 31 ("tôi muốn nhạc ambient hơn, tiếng piano mờ ảo hơn"): on ke-chuyen-mong, the piano a little further and hazier and through a soft echo. Round 32 ("tôi vẫn thích tiếng piano gần tai hơn"): on ke-chuyen-gan, the piano near again (as in ke-chuyen-relax), the hall, haze and echo kept.
